highlight.title: The Chelsea Detective
highlight.badge: Acorn TV Original · Season 4 Premiere · August 3
highlight.description: DI Max Arnold (Adrian Scarborough) and DS Layla Walsh (Vanessa Emme) return to investigate four new murder cases in the glamorous London borough of Chelsea. New episodes stream weekly starting August 3.

new_arrivals.title: Blue Murder Motel
new_arrivals.description: Married retired detectives Vanessa and Peter Coleman leave their cop careers behind to run a motel in a beachside New Zealand town — only for a body to turn up in Unit 3 just a week after opening.

new_arrivals.title: The Ridge
new_arrivals.description: Lauren Lyle (Outlander) stars as a Scottish anesthetist who arrives in New Zealand for her sister's wedding, only to find her dead. A psychological thriller of grief, secrets, and small-town lies.

new_arrivals.title: You're Killing Me
new_arrivals.description: Brooke Shields stars as a bestselling novelist who teams up with an aspiring podcaster to solve her friend's murder in a quaint New England town — a cozy mystery with genuine charm.

originals.title: Midsomer Murders
originals.description: The ultimate comfort watch — impossibly picturesque English villages with an impossibly high murder rate. 25+ series of warm, witty mystery.

originals.title: Agatha Raisin
originals.description: Ashley Jensen stars as the sharp London PR exec who retires to the Cotswolds and keeps stumbling into murders — funny, warm, and based on M.C. Beaton's novels.

originals.title: Art Detectives
originals.description: DI Mick Palmer (Stephen Moyer) and DC Shazia Malik solve murders connected to the world of art and antiques, from Old Master paintings to Banksy street art.

originals.title: Doc Martin
originals.description: A grumpy London surgeon retreats to a tiny Cornish fishing village as its GP in this long-running comedy drama, starring Martin Clunes as the reluctant Doc Martin.
